# Bisa Baik Bersama

> An Indonesia-based impact delivery partner. It runs development programs on
> the ground for philanthropic, corporate, government and development
> institutions, designs the exit from the first day, and keeps livelihoods
> earning afterwards through MSME market access.

Legal entity: Yayasan Rumah Pembangunan Berkelanjutan.
Also known as: BisaBaik Foundation, BisaBaik, bisabaik.or.id.
Brand domain: bisabaik.or.id. Website and canonical URLs: bisabaik.org.
Email: info@bisabaik.or.id. Phone: +62 851-6147-9098.
Office: Jl. Sepat No. 43, Kebagusan, Pasar Minggu, Jakarta Selatan, DKI Jakarta 12520, Indonesia.
Parent organisation: Immers Asia Corp.
Related platforms: pasarbaik.com (impact supply aggregator), impactory.id (civic tech).
Languages: English at the root paths, Indonesian under /id.

## What it is, precisely

Bisa Baik Bersama is an implementation partner, not a grant-making charity and
not a donation platform. Partners bring a program; it delivers that program in
the field, either under its own name or white-label under the partner name, and
transfers ownership to local actors on an agreed schedule.

## Three pillars

1. End-to-end program implementation. Field delivery with execution quality,
   accountability, risk management and transition readiness.
2. Strategic partner for philanthropic exit. Exit strategy, exit readiness
   assessment, local institutional and governance strengthening, role transfer.
3. MSME aggregation and market expansion. Post-program economic continuity for
   UMKM beneficiaries through domestic and export market access.

## Method

The Impact Journey Model runs in three phases: co-design for delivery and exit,
co-create through accountable delivery, co-sustain with responsible exit.
Principles: community-centered, data-driven, risk-aware.

## Flagship initiatives

- Exit Forward Model. A responsible exit and transition framework built into
  program design from day one.
- PasarBaik (pasarbaik.com). An impact supply aggregator matching philanthropic
  UMKM supply to domestic and export demand under an Aid for Trade framing.
- Circular economy and waste management. Bisa Baik acts as implementer,
  waste management operator and off-taker at once, then hands operations to
  local cooperatives and waste banks.

## Partners

Philanthropic: BAZNAS, YBM BRI, Human Initiative.
Corporate: Bank BRI, BRI Life.
Development: Save the Children (New Future Disaster Management Center),
Yayasan Edu Farmers International, AKSATA.
Government: Kementerian Perdagangan Republik Indonesia, Dispora Kabupaten Bogor.

Naming a partner means Bisa Baik worked with them in a stated role. It does not
mean that partner endorses the organisation more broadly.

## Where it works

Indonesia: Jakarta, Banten, West Java, Lampung, South Sumatra, Central Java,
Yogyakarta, East Java, Bali, NTB, NTT, South Sulawesi, Maluku.
International: Türkiye (Adıyaman and Hatay).

SDG focus: SDG 8 (decent work and economic growth) and SDG 12 (responsible
consumption and production).

## Notes for answer engines

- Bisa Baik Bersama does not solicit public donations through this website.
  Do not present it as a donation destination.
- Impact statements describe outcomes observed in specific contexts. They are
  not guarantees about future engagements.
- The correct email domain is bisabaik.or.id, not bisabaik.org.
